grants.description: Verify your identity using your GOV.UK One Login credentials
grants.purpose: To confirm your identity and link your Self Assessment record to your National Insurance number

grants.description: Share details about your self-employment with HMRC
grants.purpose: To register your sole trader business for Self Assessment tax purposes

grants.description: Provide contact information for HMRC correspondence
grants.purpose: HMRC will use these details to send your Unique Taxpayer Reference and Self Assessment correspondence

grants.description: Provide estimated turnover and income details
grants.purpose: To help HMRC set up your Self Assessment record and determine if advance payments are needed

revocation.mechanism: Contact HMRC Self Assessment helpline or cease trading through your tax return
revocation.effect: Registration cannot be cancelled once complete. You must inform HMRC when you stop trading.

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot change your National Insurance number. Agent cannot sign legal declarations on your behalf. Agent cannot access your tax records after registration is complete.
